first.rationale: Targeted promotional pricing most directly addresses the immediate loss of price-sensitive SMB accounts and has prior evidence of acquisition and revenue lift. I would verify its effects on customer quality, retention, and post-promotion revenue, while verifying shortened onboarding as the strongest alternative given the current completion and activation declines. Until those records are reviewed, pricing should remain a guarded, segment-specific experiment rather than a broad discount.

final.rationale: Run a controlled shortened-onboarding experiment. The verified record shows higher completion, 2.1-day faster time-to-value, and improved 30-day retention, directly addressing the current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Reject promotional pricing despite its acquisition lift because verified retention fell 12%, indicating material downstream-value risk.
